name: acme-agentic-sdlc-lab
description: IBM Bob, watsonx Orchestrate ADK, and Bob Shell CI/CD case study with evidence-first human release governance.

scripts.test: npm run test:portal && npm run test:api && npm run test:openapi && npm run test:release-scan && npm run test:history-scan && npm run test:documentation-scan && npm run test:sbom && npm run test:licenses && npm run test:release-audit && npm run test:archive-verify && npm run test:python-audit && npm run test:doctor && npm run test:local-environment && npm run test:guided && npm run test:bob-review && npm run test:cleanup
scripts.test:bob-review: node --test scripts/bob-gate-evidence.test.mjs scripts/bob-review-report.test.mjs scripts/bob-review-workspace.test.mjs scripts/bob-shell-review.test.mjs scripts/bob-workflow.test.mjs
scripts.e2e:built: npm run build && npm run test:built -w tests/e2e
scripts.preflight: npm run doctor && npm run secret:scan && npm run history:scan && npm run documentation:scan
scripts.verify:web: npm run secret:scan && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:agent: uv sync --project agents/store_support_agent --locked --python 3.12.10 && uv run --project agents/store_support_agent python agents/store_support_agent/scripts/validate_local.py && uv run --project agents/store_support_agent pytest -q agents/store_support_agent/tests
scripts.verify: npm run verify:web && npm run verify:agent
